peak-body: Japan has a three-day weekend on 21–23 November for Labour Thanksgiving Day. Our priority lane bypasses the queue — you're through in under 10 minutes.
faq-night: IndiGo's new daily Mumbai service, added with the winter schedule, is timetabled into Terminal 2 at 10:00 and back out at 19:05 — outside both of those windows. Our service is available 24/7 regardless of flight time.
faq-delay: No problem at all. We monitor your flight in real time and adjust accordingly. Our staff will be there whether your flight lands early, on time, or late — just as one of our guests experienced when their flight arrived 1.5 hours ahead of schedule. Diwali falls on Sunday 8 November this year, so flights from India are at their fullest in the days around it — we work from your actual landing time, not the timetable.
faq-connection: Fast Track Arrival ends once you are through immigration at Terminal 2; it does not cover the domestic terminal. If your international flight lands at T2 and your domestic flight leaves from Terminal 1, the connection is a separate journey: immigration, a terminal change and a second check-in. Cebu Pacific resumes Hanoi–Clark on 20 November (Wed, Fri, Sun) — an international departure from Terminal 2, not a domestic connection.
